title: BOSS: The Calculator Shrine
hints: README 'New syntax' and the grammar: one function per rule, each returning `Right (expr, leftoverTokens)`. Do eval and pretty first, then parseAtom, parseProduct, parseSum, calc.

eval: recurse into both sides; only Div needs a zero check. pretty: "(" ++ left ++ " op " ++ right ++ ")". parseAtom: TNum → Num; TOpen → parseSum, then expect TClose. parseProduct/parseSum: parse one operand, then loop: while the next token is your operator, parse another operand and wrap (left-associative). calc: parseExpr, then eval.
Other data: `sumList`/`go` in the README is exactly the 'operand (op operand)*' loop · `(+) <$> Right 2 <*> Right 3` → Right 5.

`parseSum tokens = parseProduct tokens >>= uncurry go` where `go lhs (TPlus : rest) = parseProduct rest >>= \(rhs, rest') -> go (Add lhs rhs) rest'` (same for TMinus/Sub) and `go lhs rest = Right (lhs, rest)` · `calc input = parseExpr input >>= eval`.
